origin.description: Store values in a dictionary that lasts for this process.

arguments.name: algo
arguments.text: Hash used as the cache key when memoise uses this cache. sha512 is the default.

origin.details: This is the old-style cache. memoise calls its digest method instead of the default key function.
origin.value: A cache with set, get, has_key, drop_key, reset, keys, and digest.
origin.example:
cm <- cache_memory()
cm$set("k", 7)
got <- cm$get("k")
cm$drop_key("k")
cat(paste(got, as.integer(cm$has_key("k"))), "\n", sep = "")
